name: round-2855-prs
title: Fix round #2855 — the PRs waiting for your play

cases.title: PR #2856 · click the foci, then build a triangle on them
cases.lookFor: Steps after the lines: Press «הצג מוקדים» on the ellipse row. Then: Click the dot F₁ on the canvas and confirm the letter (✓). Then: Click the dot F₂ and confirm. Then: Type «משולש F1F2D». — Look for: Two new rows «F1 מוקד ימני של האליפסה» and «F2 מוקד שמאלי של האליפסה», and the triangle's base on the foci at (±√2, 0).
cases.before: The foci were labels only; «משולש F1F2D» built two new free points.

cases.title: PR #2859 · «נתונה פרבולה» is a free parabola that turns
cases.lookFor: A parabola is drawn; pressing «הציגו תצורה אחרת» moves it and turns it (right, left, up, down), and the givens equation follows.

cases.title: PR #2859 · «נתונה אליפסה» is a free ellipse
cases.lookFor: An ellipse off the origin, with letters h, k, a, b in its row; «הציגו תצורה אחרת» moves and reshapes it. «אליפסה קנונית» (try it) stays at the origin.

cases.title: PR #2860 · p2-15: all three ellipses come first
lines: נתונה אליפסה שציריה הם צירי השיעורים
נתון ישר l המקביל לציר ה-x
הישר l חותך את האליפסה בנקודות A ו-B
cases.lookFor: The first drawing and the next two presses show three DIFFERENT ellipses; mirror images only from press 3 on.
cases.before: The third ellipse appeared on press 13.

cases.title: PR #2860 · 2-D: the right angle moves to a new vertex on each press
lines: מנקודה A הוציאו משיק למעגל בנקודה B
cases.lookFor: Press «הציגו תצורה אחרת» twice; the first press can show «חושב…» for up to ~30 s (question Q7 on the inbox). Look for: each press puts the right angle at a new vertex, with no mirror image in between.
cases.before: The distinct triangles came on presses 0, 2 and 4, with mirrors between.

cases.title: PR #2862 · 3-D: a new point with letters shares k with B
cases.lookFor: N at height 3, N.x equal to B.z; «הציגו תצורה אחרת» moves p.

cases.title: PR #2862 · 3-D: «N(k,p,3)» on a blank page
cases.lookFor: N is drawn at height 3; the freedom count shows 2.

cases.title: PR #2863 · hiding the rhombus height hides H, the knee and 4.8
cases.lookFor: Steps after the lines: Click the segment DH and choose «הסתירו קטע». — Look for: No H, no right-angle mark, no «4.8»; the rhombus and its «5» unchanged; row 2 shows «מוסתר».
cases.before: H, the knee and 4.8 stayed after hiding DH.

cases.title: PR #2863 · «מוסתר» brings it all back
cases.lookFor: Steps after the lines: Hide DH as in the previous case. Then: Click «מוסתר» on row 2. — Look for: H, the knee and «4.8» are back.

cases.title: PR #2864 · «V קודקוד הפרבולה» names the vertex
cases.lookFor: V is drawn at the origin, the parabola's vertex. (Pre-play note: the view zooms right in on V, so the parabola looks almost straight; zoom out with − to see it. Tell me if that framing is wrong.)

cases.title: PR #2864 · the vertex of a moved parabola, and asking for it
cases.lookFor: V at (2, 3), and the question answers (2, 3).
cases.before: Not understood; the question was unreadable.

cases.title: PR #2864 (refusal) · a parabola has no centre — the refusal teaches the vertex
cases.lookFor: Refused: «לפרבולה אין מרכז. אם התכוונתם לקודקוד הפרבולה, כתבו «O קודקוד הפרבולה».»
cases.before: Refused without pointing to the vertex.
